		Dataset Details
	

This is a dataset containing annotated video frames of Plains zebras collected at the Ol Pejeta Conservancy (OPC) in Kenya using the semi-autonomous WildWing system. The dataset is intended for use in training and evaluating computer vision models for animal detection and classification from drone imagery. It includes frames from various sessions,
